source_text: {For $x\in\Omega\subset\mathbb R^n$, the tangent space $T_x\Omega$ may be identified with $\mathbb R^n$, so we obtain a vector field by assigning to each point $x\in\Omega$ that same $x$, now viewed as a vector in its tangent space. This identity vector field is display in Figure~\ref{fig:identity-vector-field}.}
translated_text: {对 $x\in\Omega\subset\mathbb R^n$, 可将切空间 $T_x\Omega$ 与 $\mathbb R^n$ 等同, 因而为每个点 $x\in\Omega$ 指定同一个 $x$, 但将其看作切空间中的向量, 就得到一个向量场. 此恒等向量场见 Figure~\ref{fig:identity-vector-field}.}

source_text: {If we identify $1$-forms with vector fields, then $\kappa$ corresponds to the dot product of the vector field with $x$ (or, more properly, with the identity vector field). Applied to $2$-forms in three dimensions, $\kappa$ is the cross product with $x$, and on $3$-forms it is the product of a scalar field with $x$ to get a vector field.}
translated_text: {若将 $1$-形式与向量场等同, 则 $\kappa$ 对应于向量场与 $x$ 的点积 (更准确地说, 是与恒等向量场的点积). 应用于三维中的 $2$-形式时, $\kappa$ 是与 $x$ 的叉积; 在 $3$-形式上, 它是标量场与 $x$ 相乘而得到向量场.}

source_text: {The Koszul differential $\kappa$ maps $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ to $\mathcal P_{r+1}\Lambda^{k-1}$, increasing the polynomial degree and decreasing the form degree, exactly the reverse of $d$. Thus both $\kappa d$ and $d\kappa$ map $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ to itself. The following theorem points to an intimate relation between $\kappa$ and $d$, called the \emph{homotopy formula}. In it, we write $\mathcal H_r\Lambda^k$ for the $k$-forms with \emph{homogeneous} polynomial coefficients of degree $r$.}
translated_text: {Koszul 微分 $\kappa$ 将 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ 映到 $\mathcal P_{r+1}\Lambda^{k-1}$, 提高多项式次数并降低形式次数, 与 $d$ 恰好相反. 因此 $\kappa d$ 和 $d\kappa$ 都将 $\mathcal P_r\Lambda^k$ 映到自身. 下述定理揭示了 $\kappa$ 与 $d$ 之间的密切关系, 称为\emph{同伦公式}. 其中用 $\mathcal H_r\Lambda^k$ 表示系数为次数 $r$ 的\emph{齐次}多项式的 $k$-形式.}

source_text: {Note that we have left the $0$ off from one end of each complex, since we would not have exactness there.}
translated_text: {注意, 在每个复形的一端省略了 $0$, 因为在那里不具有正合性.}

source_text: {Another important consequence is a direct sum decomposition.}
translated_text: {另一个重要推论是直和分解.}
